nodes.label: Stimulus Salience
nodes.description: Bottom-up competition from perceptually salient features.

nodes.label: Goal Relevance
nodes.description: Priority created by current goals, tasks, or needs.

nodes.label: Learned Value Priority
nodes.description: Attentional priority learned from prior value/reward associations.

nodes.label: Novelty
nodes.description: Detection of new or unexpected information.

nodes.label: Uncertainty
nodes.description: Perceived unresolved state that may motivate information seeking.

nodes.label: Expected Information Gain
nodes.description: Expected reduction of uncertainty or increase in useful knowledge.

nodes.label: Learning Progress
nodes.description: Perceived progress in understanding that can sustain exploration.

nodes.label: Subjective Value
nodes.description: Expected utility, reward, or worth assigned to information/action.

nodes.label: Personal Relevance
nodes.description: Degree to which information matters to current concerns or goals.

nodes.label: Valence
nodes.description: Positive-negative affective quality.

nodes.label: Arousal
nodes.description: Level of affective activation/action readiness.

nodes.label: Self Relevance
nodes.description: Fit with self-concept or personally important identity.

nodes.label: Group Identity
nodes.description: Identification with a social group or category.

nodes.label: Norm Salience
nodes.description: Accessibility of group norms and expected conduct.

nodes.label: Perceived Homophily
nodes.description: Perceived similarity in values, beliefs, characteristics, or experience.

nodes.label: Trustworthiness
nodes.description: Perceived honesty, fairness, integrity, and goodwill.

nodes.label: Expertise
nodes.description: Perceived knowledge, skill, experience, or competence.

nodes.label: Authenticity
nodes.description: Perceived genuineness and non-fabricated self-presentation.

nodes.label: Consistency
nodes.description: Perceived stability and reliability across time and claims.

nodes.label: Parasocial Closeness
nodes.description: Perceived relational closeness to a creator/source.

nodes.label: Familiarity
nodes.description: Accumulated familiarity through repeated exposure.

nodes.label: Affective Attachment
nodes.description: Emotional attachment to a creator/source.

nodes.label: Sharing
nodes.description: Behavioral propensity to forward or share content.

nodes.label: Recommending
nodes.description: Active recommendation of a creator/message to others.

nodes.label: Identity Signaling
nodes.description: Transmission used to express or reinforce identity.

nodes.label: Practical Transmission
nodes.description: Transmission because information is useful to another person.

nodes.label: Reward Learning
nodes.description: Updating value and future action tendencies from outcomes.

nodes.label: Context-Response Association
nodes.description: Association between recurring context cues and responses.

nodes.label: Automaticity
nodes.description: Reduced deliberation as a context-linked response becomes habitual.
